Description: Rigid D99 -> NMT2Sym (ITK text, LPS). mode-image: resamples D99 into NMT2Sym; as a point map it takes NMT2Sym points to D99 points.
Method: ANTs translation->rigid->affine (MI, centre-of-mass start) of tpl-D99_res-05_T1w_brain.nii.gz to tpl-NMT2Sym_res-05_T1w_brain.nii.gz; rigid = polar decomposition of the affine, agreeing with it at the NMT2Sym brain centroid
